_comment: Provenance for vendored third-party browser assets. tests/test_no_external_subresources.py verifies each file still matches its recorded sha256.

assets.name: lucide
assets.why_not_tree_shaken: ADMZ has no JS build toolchain (no package.json, no bundler config). Tree-shaking the 92 icons in use would make the update path 'install node deps and run a bundler' in a Python project, which will not be maintained. 404 KB over loopback is the cheaper trade.
